retrospective_diff._reading: The fold's own populations move substantially between the two readings of the SAME valid time, so K = f(S) and the retrospective axis are both live. The question-level diff is empty because the paths that answered walk relationship types whose selected cohort is identical at both system times -- which is a property of this corpus, stated per path above, and NOT a demonstration that asking now and asking then agree. A reader who wanted the question-level difference would need a corpus whose canonical questions traverse a belief that was superseded; that is a generator property and it is named here rather than left for someone to infer from an empty dict.
